title: Golang: Heap Allocation using escape analysis
comment_samples: It was really good and easy. Thankyou.  😊
description:
In this video I show how to perform escape analysis on a Go program to check its Heap Allocation. This might give indication on how one can improve performance of a Go program. 

Command:
go build -gcflags=-m . 

Link to Blog Post:
https://tennexas.com/how-to-check-improve-performance-in-go/
